[[Larnaca]], [[Cyprus]] | capacity = 10,230 | chrtitle = | chairman = | mgrtitle = Manager | manager = [[Nestor El Maestro]] | league = {{Cypriot football updater|Anorthosis}} | season = {{Cypriot football updater|Anorthosis2}} | position = {{Cypriot football updater|Anorthosis3}} | website = {{URL|http://anorthosisfc.com.cy/}} | pattern_la1 = _adidasstriped24wrb | pattern_b1 = _adidasstriped24wrb | pattern_ra1 = _adidasstriped24wrb | pattern_sh1 = _adidassquadra25rbw | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 0000FF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = 0000FF | shorts1 = 0000FF | socks1 = 0000FF | pattern_la2 = _adidasicon25ub | pattern_b2 = _adidasicon25ub | pattern_ra2 = _adidasicon25ub | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 }} {{Anorthosis Famagusta sections}} '''Anorthosis Famagusta''' ({{langx|el|Ανόρθωση Αμμοχώστου|translit=Anorthosi Ammochostou}}) is a [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] [[association football|football]] club, part of the Famagusta multi-sport club founded in 1911 in [[Varosha, Famagusta|Varosha]], [[Famagusta]].[http://www.anorthosis.com/historyevents Ιστορικά γεγονότα] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140722020902/http://www.anorthosis.com/historyevents|date=22 July 2014}}, Anorthosis Famagusta Official Website Anorthosis was one of the founding clubs of the [[Cyprus Football Association]] in 1934.{{Cite web |title=Successes & Achievements |url=https://anorthosisfc.com.cy/anorthosis/epitychies-amp-kataktiseis/ |access-date=2022-03-01 |website=Ανόρθωσις Αμμοχώστου Ποδόσφαιρο |language=el |archive-date=1 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220301192318/https://anorthosisfc.com.cy/anorthosis/epitychies-amp-kataktiseis/ |url-status=live }} After the [[Turkish invasion of Cyprus]] in 1974, they were forced to relocate to [[Larnaca]] where they now play their home matches at the [[Antonis Papadopoulos Stadium]]. The club's original stadium, [[GSE Stadium|GSE]], has been abandoned since 1974 and is in poor condition. One of the most successful clubs in Cypriot football, Anorthosis have won 13 [[Cypriot First Division|National Championships]], 11 [[Cypriot Cup|cups]] and 6 [[Cypriot Super Cup|Super Cups]]. Anorthosis is one of three Cypriot clubs never to have been relegated to the [[Cypriot Second Division|second division]], was the first Cypriot club to participate in the [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] group stage, and the second Cypriot club to qualify for the [[UEFA Europa Conference League|Europa Conference League]] group stage."}}
